repair.first_broken_edge: verify_recurrence_admission omitted pending_fixture_ids from its authenticated return projection
repair.change: return the exact pending_fixture_ids already validated against the sealed admission, recurrence target/request contract, and bound decision

preserved_fail_closed_contract: missing or forged pending identities fail the existing target/request or decision-identity verification
missing Chainwielder, unmatched targets, stale revisions, wrong purpose, bad seal, bad source, or bad actor remain rejected
the verified projection is derived only after all binding and suite revision checks pass

validation.focused_command: pixi run pytest -q tests/test_recurrence_admission.py tests/test_phase1_raid_foundation_capture.py -k 'chainwielder_checkpoint or composite_checkpoint or checkpoint_arm or checkpoint_pre_route or fixture_expansion_rejects_missing_or_extra_request_target'

verified: the authenticated composite admission survives create, verify, and checkpoint arm
pending fixture identities remain controlled by existing sealed verification
no target-set or gameplay behavior changed
refuted: the verified projection may omit a field required by its downstream target-contract consumer
unproven: the fresh map-669 production replay and revisions 4/5/5
any gameplay canary or boss result

next_action: Run one fresh exact-current map-669 fixture replay with the preserved composite admission and completion watchdog; no retry.
